spans.s:
m. (-कः)
The name of a saint; also called MĀRKAṆḌEYA.
E.
मृकण्ड the name of his father, and वुन् aff.

m. (-ण्डुः)
The saint MĀRKAṆḌEYA.
E.
मृकण्डु his father, अण् aff., but the word unchanged.

r. 1st cl. (मृक्षति)
To accumulate, to collect, to fill.
r. 10th cl. (मृक्षयति)
1 To mix, to mingle, to blend or combine.
2 To speak incorrectly.
